item.title: First Prints with Bambu Lab P2S & Automating Blender with MCP
item.description: An exploration into physical and digital creation. What happens when you mix a Bambu Lab P2S, printer poo, n8n, Claude Code, and a two-way sync for Blender Studio? Here are the key lessons learned from building a new workflow.
